scope: Publication requirements for exact Indian retail product records; unknown fields remain null and block only calculations needing those inputs.
sharedRequired: actual retail net mass or unit count (not shipping weight)
unconditional listed INR price with dated exact match
label serving basis or explicit unknown
excludedPriceTypes: calculated prices for unavailable pack sizes
historical estimates or forward-filled missing quarters

categories.label: Protein
categories.comparisonNote: Costs derive from verified net grams and labelled concentration.
categories.checks: Verify the exact flavour,1/2/4kg net retail pack, protein grams/serving and gram serving weight before deriving percent. Never multiply a1kg price to invent a2/4kg offer.

categories.label: Creatine
categories.comparisonNote: Costs derive from verified net grams and labelled concentration.
categories.checks: Record the labelled compound, form, grade and ingredient concentration for the exact flavour. Flavoured material is not assumed100%creatine. Derivative masses are not equivalent free-creatine amounts.

categories.label: Ashwagandha
categories.comparisonNote: Root powder, extracts and blends are distinct profiles. Compare material costs within the same formulation; a standardized extract mass is required to calculate withanolides.
categories.checks: Separate root powder, root extract and standardized extract component mass. Withanolides need a verified extract basis; a dry-root equivalent is not extract mass.

categories.label: Fish Oil
categories.comparisonNote: EPA+DHA and total fish-oil mass are recorded separately. Compare the chemical form and actual label serving alongside cost.
categories.checks: Separate EPA,DHA and oil mass. Never infer EPA/DHA split or ester form. Algal omega3 is not classified as fish oil.

categories.label: Vitamin D
categories.comparisonNote: Vitamin D amounts use IU with micrograms shown alongside (1 Âµg = 40 IU). Strength comparisons do not specify intake frequency.
categories.checks: Use IU/Âµg consistency (1Âµg=40IU); strength does not specify intake frequency.

categories.label: Magnesium
categories.comparisonNote: Cost comparisons use explicitly labelled elemental magnesium. Glycinate, citrate and other compound masses are stored separately and are not substituted for elemental content.
categories.checks: Elemental magnesium must be explicit; chelate/compound mass stays separate.

categories.label: ZMC
categories.comparisonNote: ZMC means zinc + magnesium + calcium. Compare cost per label serving and each declared elemental mineral separately; the three mineral masses are not added into a single strength score.
categories.checks: All zinc,magnesium andcalcium must be declared. ZMA is not ZMC. Conflicting serving panels leave nutrient/serving inputs unknown.

categories.label: Glutathione
categories.comparisonNote: Compare oral glutathione amounts only when the exact label serving is verified. Reduced, liposomal and combination formulations are recorded separately; ingredient cost does not establish absorption or clinical benefit. Total blend mass and precursors are not counted as glutathione.
categories.checks: Precursor,liposomal complex mass and actual glutathione payload differ. Resolve purity/standardization basis before active-cost calculation.

categories.label: Melatonin
categories.comparisonNote: The 1 mg quantity is a cost comparison unit, not an intake recommendation. Check exact strength, release formulation and other ingredients. Higher strength or lower ingredient cost does not establish better sleep or suitability.
categories.checks: Keep full label serving and release formulation. Gummies and blend coingredients need their own label facts; a capsule shell is not vegan certification.

categories.label: Biotin
categories.comparisonNote: Biotin is recorded in micrograms, not milligrams. Compare only verified label amounts and servings; a higher strength does not establish a hair or nail benefit. Check other ingredients and tell your laboratory about biotin use.
categories.checks: Record actual biotin in micrograms. Botanical extract mass is not biotin payload.

categories.label: Vitamin C
categories.comparisonNote: Vitamin C amount is distinct from the mass of amla, citrus, mineral ascorbate or a multi-ingredient blend. Costs use the declared vitamin C per verified label serving; chemical forms and other ingredients remain separate profiles.
categories.checks: Actual declared vitaminC amount is distinct from amla/acerola blend mass.

categories.label: Vitamin B
categories.comparisonNote: B-complex and individual B vitamins are different profiles. Compare cost per label serving and each vitamin separately, in its own units. Vitamin masses are never added into a B-strength score; a one-vitamin product is not a complete B-complex. Folic acid, methylfolate and dietary folate equivalents remain separate.
categories.checks: Keep per-vitamin units and declared nutrient profile. No combined B-vitamin strength score.

categories.label: Folic Acid & Folate
categories.comparisonNote: Folic acid mass, methylfolate mass and dietary folate equivalents (DFE) are recorded separately. No serving, chemical-form or DFE conversion is assumed. The primary reference cost uses only explicitly labelled folic acid; methylfolate and DFE costs, when verified, are separate calculations. Combination products can also contain iron or other ingredients.
categories.checks: Do not substitute folic acid,methylfolate and dietary folate equivalents or infer interconversion.

categories.label: L-Arginine
categories.comparisonNote: Free-form L-arginine and arginine compounds or blends are distinct. Costs use explicitly labelled L-arginine per verified serving; a nitric-oxide mechanism does not establish an exercise benefit.
categories.checks: Keep free L-arginine separate from AAKG compound material.

categories.label: L-Carnitine
categories.comparisonNote: Free L-carnitine, L-carnitine L-tartrate and acetyl-L-carnitine are separate profiles. Compound mass is not converted into free L-carnitine. The compound-cost comparison applies within the same stated chemical form; fat transport biology does not establish a fat-loss benefit.
categories.checks: Do not equate tartrate/acetyl compound mass with free L-carnitine; liquid products need a separate supported measurement model.

categories.label: BCAA
categories.comparisonNote: BCAA totals include leucine, isoleucine and valine only. Powder weight, flavouring and electrolytes are not BCAA mass. Ratios and total amounts remain separate; BCAAs are a subset of EAAs and are not a complete protein.
categories.checks: Leucine,isoleucine,valine and total BCAA share one serving; verify subset sums.

categories.label: EAA
categories.comparisonNote: EAA total uses an explicit label amount rather than net scoop mass. BCAAs overlap with the EAA profile and are not added again to the EAA total. A blend name alone does not establish that all nine essential amino acids or their individual amounts are disclosed.
categories.checks: BCAA are a subset of EAA. Do not add overlapping totals.

categories.label: Pre-workout
categories.comparisonNote: Pre-workout is a multi-ingredient product class, not one active ingredient. Serving cost does not measure efficacy or completeness. Caffeine, citrulline, citrulline malate and other actives stay separate; proprietary blend weights are not allocated to individual ingredients. Check all stimulant sources, existing creatine/amino acids and exact formula notes.
categories.checks: No combined potency score. Unknown total caffeine stays unknown when only caffeine components or botanicals are disclosed.

categories.label: Citrulline
categories.comparisonNote: Free L-citrulline and citrulline malate are distinct label profiles. Malate compound mass and a declared ratio are not converted to free L-citrulline. Compare the same form and verified label serving; a nitric-oxide mechanism or ingredient cost does not establish exercise benefit.
categories.checks: Free citrulline and citrulline-malate material/ratio remain separate; do not presume a free payload from molecular ratios.

categories.label: Beta-Alanine
categories.comparisonNote: Beta-alanine amounts use the exact stated label serving. Powder serving mass and a pre-workout blend total are not assumed to be beta-alanine. Check overlap with pre-workouts; tingling is not a measure of efficacy.
categories.checks: Serving scoop mass and actual beta-alanine payload must match the exactflavour.

categories.label: Taurine
categories.comparisonNote: Taurine amounts refer to the stated label serving. Taurine and caffeine are separate ingredients; the presence of taurine does not establish a stimulant effect or describe every ingredient in an energy drink or pre-workout.
categories.checks: Use actual taurine mass on the supported powder/capsule serving; no energy-drink equivalence.

categories.label: Betaine
categories.comparisonNote: Betaine anhydrous (trimethylglycine / TMG) and betaine hydrochloride (HCl) are distinct forms with different research and marketed uses. HCl compound mass is not converted to anhydrous betaine or treated as a sports-performance equivalent. Compare matching forms; added digestive ingredients remain separate.
categories.checks: Separate betaine anhydrous/TMG and betaineHCl compound masses.

categories.label: HMB
categories.comparisonNote: HMB payload, calcium HMB compound and free-acid HMB are recorded separately. No salt-to-active conversion, absorption multiplier or equivalence between forms is inferred. Label amounts do not establish muscle gain or the treatment of muscle loss; compare study populations and formulations in the guide.
categories.checks: Separate HMB payload,calcium-HMB complex and free-acid material.

categories.label: Collagen
categories.comparisonNote: Compare label-serving cost and like ingredient materials separately. Hydrolysed peptide mass, mixed collagen-complex mass and native type II ingredient mass are not equivalent potency measures. Type labels do not establish tissue targeting, independent purity or clinical benefit.
categories.checks: Peptide mass,mixed hydrolysed complex and native typeII ingredients stay separate. Mixedcomplex individualtype/source weights stay unknown. No plant builder, topical mask, total protein or precursor mass is counted as collagen.

marketplaceRules: Keep brand/manufacturer identity separate from retailer and named seller.
Match the exact selected product ID, variant, flavour, formulation, pack size and packaging before enriching an existing record.
Record separately dated retailer quotes on the existing exact pack; do not duplicate the pack or replace manufacturer prices and history.
A new retailer-sourced primary pack must name its retailer, seller when disclosed, exact variant URL and label evidence.
Use the actual composition panel over a contradictory marketing image; retain the conflict in notes and unknown quantities as null.
A rounded pounds option needs separately reviewed explicit net gram label evidence; never round a pounds conversion to invent a 1/2/4 kg protein pack.
New current listings do not establish historical prices, launch dates, authenticity, clinical efficacy or independent assay results.
Nutrabay sources require the exact selected pId, vId, SKU, brand, flavour/pack attributes and ordinary sale price; parent/range prices and unrelated redirect links cannot replace the selected record.
